# contiguous zone

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:overlayTypeContiguousZone`](gmeow-overlayTypeContiguousZone.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/overlayTypeContiguousZone>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

A band of water extending from the outer edge of the territorial sea to up to 24 nautical miles from the baseline, in which the coastal state may exercise control to prevent infringement of its customs, fiscal, immigration, or sanitary laws (UNCLOS [`Article`](../classes/gmeow-Article.md) 33).
